ns2:course.label: Financial Engineering I
ns2:course.description: Provides an introduction to modern techniques for pricing options, swaps, and related financial instruments; the use of such instruments in managing financial risk; and the measurement and management of their risks. Prerequisite: FIN 520; or MBA 505 - Section G (Finance II); or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: FIN 520; or MBA 505 - Section G (Finance II); or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS:Finance -UIUC, MS: Finance Cost Rec -UIUC, MS: Finance - UIUC, MS: Finance Cost Rec - UIUC, or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
